faqs.q: What is Double-Eye Cable Sock used for?
faqs.a: Double-Eye Cable Sock is a woven pulling grip for drawing cable or hose through ducts and over rollers. It is a pulling grip, not a lifting sling. It is listed in 11 sizes, 6-10 mm to 120-150 mm.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Double-Eye Cable Sock, such as IH-LR-CS-DE-6-10MM?
faqs.a: Double-Eye Cable Sock part numbers begin with IH-LR-CS-DE and end in a size code: IH-LR-CS-DE-6-10MM is the 6-10 mm size and IH-LR-CS-DE-120-150MM is the 120-150 mm size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes does Double-Eye Cable Sock come in?
faqs.a: Double-Eye Cable Sock is listed in 11 sizes, 6-10 mm to 120-150 mm, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-LR-CS-DE-6-10MM and IH-LR-CS-DE-120-150MM. The table includes 6-10 mm: minimum breaking load 250 kg and 120-150 mm: minimum breaking load 6000 kg.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Double-Eye Cable Sock?
faqs.a: For Double-Eye Cable Sock, match the sock to the cable or hose outside diameter, which for this listing runs from 6-10 mm up to 120-150 mm, and keep the pull within the breaking load with a margin.

faqs.q: What is the breaking load of Double-Eye Cable Sock?
faqs.a: Double-Eye Cable Sock is listed with a minimum breaking load of 250 to 6,000 kg, rising with size: 6-10 mm is rated 250 kg and 120-150 mm is rated 6000 kg. That is a pulling figure, so it is not a lifting rating and the pull should stay well below it.

faqs.q: What material and finish is Double-Eye Cable Sock supplied in?
faqs.a: The listing for Double-Eye Cable Sock does not state the material or the finish. Tell us the environment it will work in and any material standard or coating you need, and we confirm what the maker can supply before you order.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate apply to Double-Eye Cable Sock?
faqs.a: For Double-Eye Cable Sock, the listing gives its documentation as: Manufacturer's test certificate. For third-party certification or a witnessed proof test, say so on the RFQ before the order is placed.

faqs.q: What does Double-Eye Cable Sock connect to or work with?
faqs.a: For Double-Eye Cable Sock, a cable sock attaches to a pulling rope or winch line through its eye, usually with a swivel to stop twist, and grips the cable as the pull tightens.

faqs.q: How should Double-Eye Cable Sock be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: For Double-Eye Cable Sock, check the weave for cuts, broken strands and crushed or stretched areas, and the eye or loop for wear, before every pull. Retire a sock that has been overloaded or damaged, and never use one for lifting.

faqs.q: How does Double-Eye Cable Sock differ from High-Voltage Cable Sock (Cable Pulling Grip)?
faqs.a: Double-Eye Cable Sock differs from [High-Voltage Cable Sock (Cable Pulling Grip)](/p/high-voltage-cable-sock-cable-pulling-grip) in its size range 6-10 mm to 120-150 mm against 25-70 mm to 500-630 mm; minimum breaking load 250 to 6,000 kg against 3,000 to 6,500 kg.

faqs.q: How are Double-Eye Cable Sock shipped, and can they be exported from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We ship Double-Eye Cable Sock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Do you keep Double-Eye Cable Sock in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. Double-Eye Cable Sock is in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, with worldwide shipping and the best lead times. Tell us the part numbers, quantities and destination on [the contact page](/contact) and we will quote.
